duration.text: The Chinese language program at Jiangsu Normal University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1736 USD/per year ￥ 12500 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) One electronic ID photo2) The first page of the passport (the passport validity period should be more than 12 months)3) For those under 18 years old, a guardian certificate signed by parents in China must be provided4) Bank deposit certificate (more than 5000 US dollars)5) No criminal record certificate

requirements.text: (1) Hold a foreign nationality, be friendly towards China, have no criminal record, be in good health, and meet the health standards for foreign students in China as stipulated by the Ministry of Education (those who fail the physical examination after arrival will not be registered);(2) Have good conduct, abide by Chinese laws and regulations and school rules, and respect Chinese customs and habits;(3) Generally, be at least 18 years old, under 35 years old for undergraduate students, and under 40 years old for graduate students (age is calculated as of May 31, 2025);(4) Have excellent grades and good abilities in listening, speaking, reading and writing in Chinese, English or Russian;(2) Educational requirements:(1) Applicants for language preparatory programs and undergraduate programs must have a high school degree or above;(2) Applicants for master's programs must have a bachelor's degree or equivalent;(3) Applicants for doctoral programs must have a master's degree or equivalent.(3) Language requirements:Undergraduate students: Students choosing Chinese language instruction must provide a HSK-4 certificate (180 points or above), and students from non-English speaking countries choosing English language instruction must provide TOEFL or IELTS score certificates (IELTS 5.5 points, TOEFL written test 70 points or above and equivalent level, or participate in internal tests, with outstanding candidates given priority);Master/Doctoral students: Applicants for Chinese language instruction must provide a HSK-5 certificate (180 points or above); Students from non-English speaking countries choosing English language instruction must provide TOEFL or IELTS score certificates. (IELTS 6.0 points, TOEFL written test 80 points or above and equivalent level, or participate in internal tests, with outstanding candidates given priority.)
